CREATE TABLE `tblappointment6` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `appointmentCode` varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  `requestDescription` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `createAt` datetime(6) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  `saleStaffId` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `vehicleId` int NOT NULL,
  `appointmentSlotId` int NOT NULL,
  `customerId` int NOT NULL,
  `activeSlotId` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'RECEIVED')) then `appointmentSlotId` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `appointmentCode` (`appointmentCode`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_active_slot` (`activeSlotId`),
  KEY `saleStaffId` (`saleStaffId`),
  KEY `vehicleId` (`vehicleId`),
  KEY `appointmentSlotId` (`appointmentSlotId`),
  KEY `customerId` (`customerId`),
  CONSTRAINT `tblappointment6_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`saleStaffId`) REFERENCES `tblemployee6` (`memberId`),
  CONSTRAINT `tblappointment6_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`vehicleId`) REFERENCES `tblvehicle6` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tblappointment6_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`appointmentSlotId`) REFERENCES `tblappointmentslot6` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `tblappointment6_ibfk_4` FOREIGN KEY (`customerId`) REFERENCES `tblcustomer6` (`memberId`),
  CONSTRAINT `tblappointment6_chk_1` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'RECEIVED',_utf8mb4'COMPLETED',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=4 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

objects.name: vwinvoice6
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `vwinvoice6` AS select `i`.`id` AS `id`,`i`.`invoiceCode` AS `invoiceCode`,`i`.`issueDate` AS `issueDate`,`i`.`repairOrderId` AS `repairOrderId`,`i`.`paymentId` AS `paymentId`,(coalesce(`s`.`total`,0) + coalesce(`p`.`total`,0)) AS `totalAmount` from ((`tblinvoice6` `i` left join (select `tblserviceusage6`.`repairOrderId` AS `repairOrderId`,sum(`tblserviceusage6`.`saleUnitPrice`) AS `total` from `tblserviceusage6` group by `tblserviceusage6`.`repairOrderId`) `s` on((`s`.`repairOrderId` = `i`.`repairOrderId`))) left join (select `tblpartusage6`.`repairOrderId` AS `repairOrderId`,sum((`tblpartusage6`.`usedQuantity` * `tblpartusage6`.`saleUnitPrice`)) AS `total` from `tblpartusage6` group by `tblpartusage6`.`repairOrderId`) `p` on((`p`.`repairOrderId` = `i`.`repairOrderId`)))

objects.name: vwsparepart6
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `vwsparepart6` AS select `p`.`id` AS `id`,`p`.`partCode` AS `partCode`,`p`.`partName` AS `partName`,`p`.`description` AS `description`,`p`.`unit` AS `unit`,`p`.`technicalSpecifications` AS `technicalSpecifications`,`p`.`unitPrice` AS `unitPrice`,`p`.`image` AS `image`,`p`.`partBrandId` AS `partBrandId`,`p`.`categoryId` AS `categoryId`,(coalesce(`r`.`qty`,0) - coalesce(`u`.`qty`,0)) AS `stockQuantity` from ((`tblsparepart6` `p` left join (select `tblreceiptdetail6`.`sparePartId` AS `sparePartId`,sum(`tblreceiptdetail6`.`receiptQuantity`) AS `qty` from `tblreceiptdetail6` group by `tblreceiptdetail6`.`sparePartId`) `r` on((`r`.`sparePartId` = `p`.`id`))) left join (select `tblpartusage6`.`sparePartId` AS `sparePartId`,sum(`tblpartusage6`.`usedQuantity`) AS `qty` from `tblpartusage6` group by `tblpartusage6`.`sparePartId`) `u` on((`u`.`sparePartId` = `p`.`id`)))
